label: AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for all birds (figshare v7)
bibliographic_citation: Tobias JA, Sheard C, Pigot AL, Devenish AJM, Yang J, Sayol F, et al. (2022) AVONET: morphological, ecological and geographical data for all birds. Ecology Letters 25:581–597.

distributions.description: AVONET Supplementary dataset 1.xlsx (size from the figshare API article record; file not downloaded or checksummed)

measurement_technique: Museum-specimen measurements (wing, tail, tarsus, beak) and compiled body mass for ~11,000 bird species, with hand-wing index and ecological traits.
role: wing morphology, hand-wing index and body mass for the flight-scaling claims (thompson1917-ch02-06, ch02-07, ch02-10); coverage of the listed taxa is expected from the 'all birds' scope but was not verified row-by-row
notes: Metadata (title, DOI, file list, license, size) read from https://api.figshare.com/v2/articles/16586228 on 2026-10-31; the 21 MB xlsx itself was not downloaded, so no sha256 is recorded.
